domains.definition: Stock ledger, available-to-promise quantities, reservations, and material-consumption events. A logical event must change the ledger once.

repositories.name: northstar/inventory-ledger
repositories.responsibility: Stock event ledger and idempotent material-consumption writes

repositories.name: northstar/inventory-api
repositories.responsibility: Availability and reservation API for downstream clients

repositories.name: northstar/inventory-ops-ui
repositories.responsibility: Operator stock adjustments and discrepancy investigation

domains.definition: Lot-scoped picks, warehouse issue confirmation, and the event outbox that delivers material-issued events.

repositories.name: northstar/warehouse-execution
repositories.responsibility: Pick confirmation, lot issue events, and outbox delivery

repositories.name: northstar/warehouse-api
repositories.responsibility: Warehouse task and lot availability API

repositories.name: northstar/warehouse-ui
repositories.responsibility: Supervisor pick queues and exception review

repositories.name: northstar/scanner-ui
repositories.responsibility: Handheld scanner lot confirmation and offline retry

domains.definition: Work-order start checks and consumption of lot-controlled raw materials at plants.

repositories.name: northstar/manufacturing-execution
repositories.responsibility: Work-order start checks and material consumption

repositories.name: northstar/mes-ui
repositories.responsibility: Shop-floor work-order start and exception display

repositories.name: northstar/production-planning-ui
repositories.responsibility: Planner schedule and material readiness view

tools.splunk: Delivery IDs, event IDs, ledger transitions, and MES exceptions
tools.reproducer: Isolated backend replay of the material-issued event
